Hello. My name is Lucas,
and here you are on my portfolio!
introducing.contentBlockSubheader: and let me introduce myself first.
introducing.contentBlockParagraph1: My name is Lucas Pausé-Chapuis, I'm a 19 year-old french student in a Computer science bachelor at the Orsay University Institute of Technology. I live in the department of Essonne, France.
introducing.contentBlockParagraph2: I’ve been passionate about computers since I was eleven, and I’ve always been fascinated by the way technology can transform our daily lives.
introducing.contentBlockParagraph3: Eager to explore creativity and experimentation, I have developed numerous projects to hone my skills in this field.
introducing.contentBlockParagraph4: I am currently looking for a three-month internship in the field of software development.
introducing.scratchFrameParagraph1: Many years ago, when I was younger, I discovered Scratch, a platform designed for creating your own games!
introducing.scratchFrameParagraph2: Since I was already curious about how computer programs work, I quickly developed a passion for this stuff. Today, I want to turn this passion into my future career.
